bio_en: Harutyun Kirakosian, known as Turbakh, was born in Kars in 1866 and belonged to the groups of the late 1880s that united as the ARF in the 1890s; he took part in Kukunian's expedition. The inseparable comrade of Tatul (Aram Aramian), he crossed the border from Kars in autumn 1895 with hundreds of fighters and roamed Mush, Bulanikh, Khnus and Alashkert, organising self-defence in Tsaghkotn with Sebouh. He fought Kurds in the Mush plain, worked in Sasun, and in the Caucasus faced the Golitsyn repression and the Tatar mobs. He spent his last years in Erzurum, near the place where Tatul had been hanged, and died there in 1913, 'a young old man' worn out by hardship.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death year from Droshak May 1913 obituary.
